All 7 tests pass. Here's a summary of all the bugs fixed, both from test failures and docstring compliance:

1. **`overlaps`** (line 13): Was using `<=` making touching intervals count as overlapping. Changed to `<` so touching intervals correctly don't overlap.

2. **`merge_intervals`** (line 21-24): Two bugs — (a) called `.sort()` which mutated the input argument (must not modify it), (b) used `<` instead of `<=` so touching intervals weren't merged. Fixed by using `sorted()` and `<=`.

3. **`total_busy_minutes`** (line 33): Docstring says "a minute covered twice counts once" but the original code just summed raw intervals without merging overlapping ones first. Now calls `merge_intervals()` to count distinct minutes.

4. **`find_free_slots`** (lines 46-56): Two bugs — (a) gap check used `>` (strict) instead of `>=`, wrongly excluding gaps exactly `min_len` long, (b) missing the trailing free slot after the last busy interval and no clamping to day boundaries. Added `>=` comparison, day boundary clamping, and post-loop trailing slot check.
